0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1, 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back) host the Golden State Warriors (0-3, 14th in the West), who are on a three-game losing streak. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery). Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 127-117 win in San Francisco on March 13, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
